title: NetworkMachineOfflinePayload
description: network.machine.offline v1 (OpenVibe.Network, plan L34: the machines hub). A machine of a person went offline: it is no longer connected to Bot. Network republishes Bot's change, so a consumer of the network's events hears about a machine once, in one place. Envelope: subject { type: machine, id: <dev_…> }, visibility internal, actor service:network.

principal_id.description: The machine's node principal on Network, when it has one.

owner.description: The person the machine belongs to.
